kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعتمل (form VIII)
# أَعْتَمِلُ (ʔaʕtamilu) /ʔaʕ.ta.mi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# أَعْتَمِلَ (ʔaʕtamila) /ʔaʕ.ta.mi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# أَعْتَمِلْ (ʔaʕtamil) /ʔaʕ.ta.mil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
